mapper.sql: id, account_id, channel_key, provider_key, channel_order_no, external_reference, event_id, amount, currency, sku_json, product_id, quantity, status, reason_code, verified_at, expires_at, raw_hash, request_id, request_fingerprint, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into marketing_channel_order_verification (account_id, channel_key, provider_key, channel_order_no, external_reference, event_id, amount, currency, sku_json, product_id, quantity, status, reason_code, verified_at, expires_at, raw_hash, request_id, request_fingerprint, create_time, update_time) values (#{accountId}, #{channelKey}, #{providerKey}, #{channelOrderNo}, #{externalReference}, #{eventId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{skuJson}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{reasonCode}, #{verifiedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{rawHash}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select from marketing_channel_order_verification where id = #{id} for update
select from marketing_channel_order_verification where account_id = #{accountId} and channel_order_no = #{channelOrderNo}
select from marketing_channel_order_verification where account_id = #{accountId} and request_id = #{requestId}
select from marketing_channel_order_verification where provider_key = #{providerKey} and event_id = #{eventId}
select from marketing_channel_order_verification where channel_order_no = #{channelOrderNo} and status = 1 order by id limit 2
mapper.update: update marketing_channel_order_verification set status = 1, product_id = #{productId}, quantity = #{quantity}, amount = #{amount}, currency = #{currency}, sku_json = #{skuJson}, raw_hash = #{rawHash}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, reason_code = null, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status in (0, 2)
mapper.select: select 'VERIFIED_WITHOUT_VOUCHER' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, null as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, v.status as status, v.create_time as occurredAt from marketing_channel_order_verification v left join marketing_channel_voucher c on c.verification_id = v.id where v.account_id = #{accountId} and v.status = 1 and c.id is null and v.create_time >= #{from} and v.create_time < #{to} union all select 'VOUCHER_UNREDEEMED' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, c.public_id as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, c.status as status, c.create_time as occurredAt from marketing_channel_voucher c join marketing_channel_order_verification v on v.id = c.verification_id where c.account_id = #{accountId} and c.status = 0 and (c.expires_at is null or c.expires_at > now()) and not exists (select 1 from marketing_channel_redemption r where r.voucher_id = c.id) and c.create_time >= #{from} and c.create_time < #{to} union all select 'REDEMPTION_REVOKED' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, c.public_id as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, r.status as status, r.revoked_at as occurredAt from marketing_channel_redemption r join marketing_channel_voucher c on c.id = r.voucher_id join marketing_channel_order_verification v on v.id = c.verification_id where c.account_id = #{accountId} and r.status = 1 and r.revoked_at >= #{from} and r.revoked_at < #{to} order by occurredAt desc limit #{limit}
